title: I purchased a license, but it's not showing up.
content: If you have completed your purchase but the license is not visible in your account, it is likely due to a temporary processing delay, particularly with certain payment methods. In rare cases, license issuance may be delayed when paying via **PayPal**. This is typically caused by a communication lag between servers (PayPal and our system). * **Average Wait Time:** Most licenses are issued within a few minutes to an hour. * If your license has not been issued after **more than 2 hours** , please contact our Support Team for assistance.
content_description: This web page provides information on potential delays in license visibility after purchase and guidance on what to do if your license isn't issued within the expected timeframe.

title: Disconnect License ID from CLO-SET Integration
content: #### **Introduction** The Disconnect CLO-SET feature allows an authorized user to disconnect a CLO-SET integration from an account or a specific License ID. After disconnection, the account or License ID will no longer be integrated with CLO-SET. #### **Who can disconnect CLO-SET integration?** Only Company IDs can disconnect their own CLO-SET integration and the CLO-SET integrations linked to License IDs under their company. #### **Where to disconnect CLO-SET integration?** 1. Disconnect Company ID's CLO-SET Integration My Page -> Account Tab -> Email Section -> Click Disconnect CLO-SET Button 2. Disconnect License ID's CLO-SET Integration License Account Admin-> License Tab -> Click a License ID to view its details -> Email Section -> Click Disconnect CLO-SET Button #### **Requirements** All Enterprise Type(Company ID & License ID) accounts integrated with CLO-SET are eligible for disconnection. #### **What happens if you disconnect CLO-SET integration for a Company ID?** 1. **You can no longer log in to Marvelous Designer using the connected CLO-SET account.** Once disconnected, that CLO-SET account can no longer be used to access Marvelous Designer. 2. **Usage and activity history cannot be accessed or retrieved.** Any usage or activity data associated with the previously connected CLO-SET account is no longer available. 3. **The email address remains unchanged and a****utomatic reconnection may occur if the same email is used.** If the same email address is registered again to this License ID, it will automatically reconnect to the corresponding CLO-SET account. So please please change the CLO-SET account email is different from this Company ID’s email. #### **What happens if you disconnect CLO-SET integration for a License ID?** 1. **The connected CLO-SET user can no longer use this License ID in Marvelous Designer.** Once disconnected, the CLO-SET account previously linked to this License ID loses access to the license. 2. **Usage and activity history cannot be accessed or retrieved.** Any usage or activity data associated with the previously connected CLO-SET account is no longer available. 3. **The License ID remains active and manageable.** Disconnecting CLO-SET does not delete the License ID. The License ID can be reassigned or connected to a different CLO-SET account. 4. **Automatic reconnection may occur if the same email is used.** If the same email address is registered again to this License ID, it will automatically reconnect to the corresponding CLO-SET account. To prevent automatic reconnection, use a different email address or leave the email field empty. ### **Steps** #### Disconnect CLO-SET for **Company ID** 1. Go to My Page and open the Account tab. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/53432365600281) 2. Click Disconnect CLO-SET and review the policy in the modal. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/53432365602329) 3. Click to proceed and check the status. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/53432381651865) * * * #### Disconnect CLO-SET for **License ID** 1. Go to the License ID details page and select a License ID and view its detail page. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/53432381653017) 2. In the Email section, click Disconnect CLO-SET. (This button is available only if the License ID is integrated with a CLO-SET account.) ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/53432365610393) 3. Click Disconnect CLO-SET and review the policy in the modal. 4. Click to Proceed and check the status. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/53432365614617)
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide for authorized users on how to disconnect their CLO-SET integration from Company IDs and License IDs, detailing the necessary steps, requirements, and implications of disconnection.

title: License ID Deletion
content: #### **Introduction** The Delete License ID feature allows authorized administrators to permanently remove a License ID from the system. This action is only available under specific conditions and requires careful review before proceeding. #### **Who can delete a License ID?** * Company ID Holder (Enterprise Administrator) #### **Where to delete a License ID?** 1. License Account Admin -> License Tab -> Delete License ID Button 2. License Account Admin -> License Tab -> License ID Detail Page -> Delete License ID Button #### **Requirements** A target License ID needs to meet the requirements below: 1. **CLO-SET integration must be disconnected first.** If the License ID is currently integrated with a CLO-SET account, the integration must be disconnected before the License ID can be deleted. 2. **Active licenses cannot be deleted.** A License ID that holds an active license cannot be deleted. To proceed, you must first end the license subscription. If this is not possible, please contact us or reach out to your account manager for further assistance. #### **What happens if you delete a License ID** Deleting a License ID permanently affects access and data associated with the license. Please review the following before proceeding. 1. **Access will be revoked** Once the License ID is deleted, users assigned to this license will no longer be able to launch Marvelous Designer or use any of its features. 2. **Activity tracking will stop** After deletion, no further activity or usage data associated with this License ID will be recorded. 3. **This action cannot be undone** A deleted License ID cannot be restored. Even if you create a new License ID with the same name, it will not be connected to any previous data. Please make sure to review everything carefully before deleting a License ID. #### **Steps** 1. Go to the License tab in License Account Admin. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/53428436213657) 2. Click Delete License ID ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/53428467931033) 3. Review the policy and proceed to the next modal. ![스크린샷 2025-12-22 오후 2.44.25.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/53571698977049) 4. Select the License ID you want to delete Only License IDs that meet the deletion policy will show up and be selectable.) ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/53428467934105) 5. Clear up all filters and check if the selected License ID(s) is deleted from the License ID list.

title: Student License Policy Updates
content: ## **Expansion in student eligibility criteria, more students to enjoy the opportunity!** We are pleased to inform you of the recent expansion in student eligibility criteria under our updated student license policy. This revision was made to enhance accessibility to the benefits of learning Marvelous Designer, thereby allowing more students to enjoy the opportunity to learn and master this valuable software at their own pace. The revised policy provides students with an affordable pricing option and an extended duration of access, allowing ample time to explore and gain in-depth knowledge of the software. Our aim is to make it easier for students to access the benefits of Marvelous Designer, encouraging them to develop and master this valuable skill set. ## **[New Policy]** ## **License Option** * Student Yearly License: USD 99/Year (Not auto-renewal), up to 2 times within 4 years (since the first purchase) ## **Qualification** * University or college * A college or university that grants degrees after completing a regular course of study of at least two years (including 2-year public or private colleges and vocational schools) * Primary or secondary school * A licensed public or private primary, middle, or high school that provides regular education * Homeschool * Attendees of private CG-related courses * Certification of courses more than 3 months or curriculum schedule and tuition receipt is required _* Students will be asked to verify the student status through either school-issued email address or relevant documents on the purchase process._ _* If you have previously received a student discount, you can still benefit from the new student discount, which offers a 1-year license discount for two times. The eligibility criteria for the discount will remain the same during the checkout process._ ## **Methods of proving student qualifications** ## **Option 1. Use the email address issued by the school** If you enter your school email address, a verification email will be sent to that email address. Please verify your account through the verification email. ## **Option 2. Submit student verification documents** ## **[Institution of a student]** If you cannot verify through your school email address, you can receive a discount by submitting one of the following documents. The submitted document must indicate your name, the name of the educational institution, and the issued date. Sensitive information such as resident registration number or grades should be removed before submission. The document must have been issued within the last six months. * Student ID card * Enrollment certificate or academic transcript * Proof of tuition payment or statement ## **[Homeschooling student]** If you are a homeschool student, you can receive a discount by submitting one of the following documents. The submitted document must indicate your name, the name of the educational institution, and the issued date. Sensitive information such as resident registration number or amount should be removed before submission. * Copy of home school contract * Current membership ID of home school association * Proof of purchase of curriculum for current academy ## **[****Private CG-focused academic institution****]** If you are attending CG-related academic institutions, you can receive a discount by submitting one of the following documents. YouTube, private streaming broadcasts, and other informal online learning will not be qualified, and only official online or offline courses with existing curricula will be qualified. * Certificate of completion issued by formal institution * Course program schedule (at least 3 months) and tuition receipt ## **Notes** * Two-time purchase license (Not auto-renewed) * When you make your first purchase, your 'student status' will be activated. The 'student status' lasts for four years, and after that, you can purchase an additional license once. You will receive two benefits over a total of four years. * Once you have redeemed your student discount, you have the option to purchase a personal license. You can choose between monthly or yearly options for the personal license. * _**Refunds are not available under any circumstances. Please make your purchase carefully.**_ # **FAQ** Q. Where can I purchase a student license? You can purchase a student license on the pricing page by clicking on "[Buy Now](https://marvelousdesigner.com/pricing?type=academic)." Q. How do I verify my student eligibility? By clicking on the "[Get Started](https://marvelousdesigner.com/pricing?type=academic)" button for the student license, the school email verification process will begin. An authentication email will be sent through your school email, and you can proceed with authentication through the email. If you are unable to authenticate through your school email, please proceed with authentication through "Manual Input" or "Document Submission." Q. What payment methods are accepted? You can make payments using credit cards, debit cards, and PayPal. The payment method is a prepayment for a one-year license. Q. Can I cancel my student license subscription midway? You cannot cancel your subscription midway, as it is a prepayment for a one-year license. Please choose carefully when making your purchase. Q. Can I keep my existing subscription for the student license? If you are currently subscribed to the previous version of the student license, you can keep your existing subscription. You can also take advantage of the benefits of the updated student license after your current subscription has expired. Q. Can I cancel my current subscription and purchase a new student license? If you have a current subscription, you cannot purchase a new student license before the expiration date of your current subscription. You can check the expiration date on the [license page](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/mypage/license). You can purchase a new student license after the expiration date, but you will need to go through the student authentication process again. Q. How long is the validity period for the second discounted offer after purchasing a student license with the first discount offer? The validity period for the second discounted offer is four years from the date of purchase of the first discounted license. Please check your student authentication validity period on the "[My Account](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/mypage)" section. Q. If I did not use the second discounted offer within the four-year validity period of the student authentication, can I receive the student discount again for a new purchase? If you did not use all the discounted offers within the validity period of the student authentication, you cannot receive additional discounts. Please check the validity period on the "[My Account](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/mypage)" section and make sure to purchase within the validity period. Q. Does student license benefit also expire when the discount benefit expires? The four-year validity period only applies at the time of purchase. If you have purchased a student license prior to the expiration date, you may still use the license even after the expiration date has passed. For instance, if you purchase a license after applying the first discount offer on November 1, 2023, you may purchase the license with a second discounted offer until October 30, 2027, which is four years from the date of purchase of the first discounted license. Moreover, the license can be used until October 30, 2028. Q. How can I renew my Student License? Students are eligible to purchase a discounted license up to two times within a four-year window. Once these two terms have been completed, the student benefit concludes. To maintain uninterrupted access to Marvelous Designer, we recommend transitioning to a **Personal License**. Please visit our [pricing page](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/en/pricing?type=personal) to compare the benefits of our Monthly and Yearly personal plans.
content_description: Discover the expanded eligibility criteria for our student license policy, designed to make learning Marvelous Designer more accessible and affordable for a wider range of students.

title: User Pool Manual
content: ## **Description:** Userpool is the feature included in the License Account Admin page along with the launch of Marvelous Designer 2024.2 for those that are integrated with CLO-SET. Please read the page in the link below for more information on account integration. [(LINK to the page](https://landing.clo-set.com/allatonce)) Userpool enhances the experience of license management with multiple & single users and provides higher security around the license usage as well. The Userpool can be found and accessed at the left side of the menu bar inside of the [license account admin page](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/teamconsole). ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438167645209) ***IMPORTANT** In order to access the User Pool, you will need to have your Company ID integrated with CLO-SET as part of our optional One-Step login process. You will need to integrate your Company ID, and End User IDs (License IDs) under your company as well, with a valid working email address in order to operate the Userpool feature fully. Any users who are invited to accounts must be integrated with CLO-SET as well. ## **Offerings:** ### **[Userpool Settings]** **![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438139894937)** **![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438202253977)** * Userpool is set to be enabled as its default upon completing account integration. * From ‘Userpool Settings’, you can also choose to turn it off for a specific License ID if you wish not to share it. * Push the slide bar in order to disable userpool from certain License ID. * If the userpool gets turned off while the selected License ID is assigned with 1 or multiple members, they will be removed afterward. ### **[Add Members]** **:** How to add the members to Userpool? * By License Account admin (Website) **![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438202459161)** **![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438168278297)** * After clicking ‘Add Member’ button, the pop up window will appear * Choose certain License ID that you want to have assigned with members who are in needs of license usage * Type in a member's ID (email address) to assign. This also can be done with multiple number of member IDs at once. * Once the add member procedure is completed followed by the steps above, the member information will appear on the page, and the email will be sent for the verification on the member’s end. * By Software (Marvelous Designer) _*'Auto Add' option has to be on for this function_ **![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438155478425)** **![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438168763033)** * The end user logs-in to Marvelous Designer with License ID * Use ‘Sign in with CLO-SET account’ or ‘Switch CLO-SET Account’ feature * CLO-SET accounts that are logged-in via software followed by above step, will be automatically added into Userpool ### **[Auto Add]** **:** What is Auto Add? * After the log-in to Marvelous Designer by License ID and signing in with a CLO-SET account inside of the Software (Sign in with CLO-SET, Switch CLO-SET Account), the CLO-SET Email is automatically added to the user pool of the corresponding License ID. _(Process)_ * Log in to Marvelous Designer with License ID ‘A’, and sign in with a CLO-SET account ‘B’ * This CLO-SET account ‘B’ will be added to user pool, underneath the License ID ‘A’ * If you switch the account to different CLO-SET account while using the software, then it will also be added to user pool, underneath the License ID ‘A’ * This option can be turned off at the License Account Admin - Userpool page. * ‘Auto Add’ option is only available for Onlineauth type of license. * ‘Auto Add’ will only work with License ID that has the email address attached. * If you try to assign members via ‘Auto Add’ option to the License ID that does not have an eligible email address attached, it will not function properly. ### **[Send Installer/ Delete]** ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438168906009) ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438156039705) * If you need to send out the installer for a certain version, or to make sure the end user received it well on their side, use the ‘Send Installer’ button. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438203487001) * Also, the delete of member ID is available by clicking on the ‘Delete’ button * If a member is using more than one License ID, then you can choose License IDs you want to delete the member from. ### **[Name Edit]** **![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438219288217)** * You can assign nicknames to members for efficient management. This helps distinguish between members and take accurate actions. Use member names to simplify team management. ***ACCOUNT STATUS** * Not Integrated / Company blocked CLO-SET account Integration **![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438203817497)** * Not Integrated/ Company allowed CLO-SET account integration **![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438156861081)** * Integrated with CLO-SET **![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438204151961)** * Integrated (End User with Standalone License and have Sub Account(Member)) **![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438190725657)** ### **Offering by License Type:** * The Userpool feature allows you to manage access to your software license. Its functionality varies depending on your license type. ### [Network Online Licenses (Academic, Enterprise) and Linux License] * Adding Members: With these licenses, you can add an unlimited number of members to your Userpool using the "Add Member" feature. * Concurrent Users: While you can add as many members as you need, the number of users who can log in and use the software at the same time is limited by the number of licenses you own. ***Note:** If the number of concurrent users exceeds your license limit, users will not be able to log in. * Platform Restriction for Linux License: A member added for a Linux license can only use the software on the Linux OS. They will be unable to log in on Mac or Windows operating systems. *Note: If a Linux license member attempts to log in on an incompatible OS, an error will occur. ### [Enterprise Standalone, Personal, and Student Licenses] * Adding a Member: These licenses are limited to a single concurrent user, so you can only add one additional member using the "Add Member" feature. *Important: If you add a new Member, it will automatically replace and delete the previous one. * Concurrent Users: The concurrent user count for these licenses is one. This means that only one user, either the main account or the added Member, can be logged in at a time. * Note: The Standalone License will be retired as of December 2, 2025. For more information on this change, please refer to the[ ](https://www.google.com/search?q=link)Marvelous Designer Standalone License Transition. * Userpool feature summary by license type **License Type** | **Number of Members** | **Concurrent User** | **Supported Operating System** ---|---|---|--- Network Online (Enterprise, Academic) | Unlimited | Equal to the number of the licenses that you own | Win, Mac Linux | Unlimited | Equal to the number of the licenses that you own | Linux only Enterprise Standalone | One | One | Win, Mac Personal | One | One | Win, Mac Student | One | One | Win, Mac
content_description: The purpose of this web page is to provide comprehensive information about the Userpool feature in Marvelous Designer 2024.2, detailing its functionality, integration requirements with CLO-SET, and management options for users and licenses.

title: Enterprise License Management Guide
content: Enterprise accounts are divided into Company ID and End User ID. For Enterprise Accounts, End User IDs (used to access software) are managed by Company IDs. To get better understanding on characteristic of each account and structure, please refer to the link below. * [Account Manual](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358380019737) **How Can I Manage My Licenses?** To manage your licenses, you will first need to login with your Company ID, at a page below. * [Account Login Page](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/member/signin) On “License Account Admin” you can view all licenses you’ve had in the past, upcoming expiration dates, delete/add end users, purchases licenses, view active end users, etc. You can access License Account Admin upon after the login, by clicking on your profile icon. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438023097369)![image \(5\).png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47437990997657) _(sample image)_ On your “Dashboard”, you can view weekly average access to licenses, how many times licenses were used, how long do users spend on the software on average and etc. _*Denied access_ Denied Access refers to concurrent access being exceeded by users. For example, if you have 10 licenses, your concurrent access will be for 10 seats. If you are sharing the 10 licenses among 20 people, this feature lets you know that one of the 10 individuals will have to log out if another user needs access, or it may be time for you to purchase additional seats. The data is only valid for the network (floating type) license holders. The contact information is also provided on the left bottom of the screen for regional managers. Regional managers can help you with how to use the License Management services, and answer any questions. Based on the location you have set for your account, you will have different regional managers. If the listed regional managers are out of office, please feel free to contact md.bizdev@marvelousdesigner.com to reach out to the entire business development team. **How Do I Know What Licenses I Have and What Can I Do With Them?** Click on the “License” tab on your left menu which will bring you to this page. ![image \(6\).png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47437977588249) _(sample image)_ **Filter section** In this section, you can search End User IDs or an email address to quickly look for the End User ID you are looking for, set to view active and expired licenses, perpetual/monthly/yearly/trial licenses and different versions of licenses. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47437977795481) _(sample image)_ **License detail section** In this section, you can see every End User ID under your Company ID. You can view information such as the email address attached to the End User ID, plan type, license type, license count, current software version, and expiration dates. You can also directly add/extend your existing seats, or purchase a new license through this menu option. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438040393497) _(sample image)_ **Add/extend option** You can add another license to the same End User ID or extend the license period before the period ends. Both actions can only be done before the license expires. **New license option** New License option allows you to renew licenses past the expiration date. This action can only be done after the license expires. **Trade-In option** Perpetual license is eligible for our 'Trade-In' service, which is to convert perpetual license to annual type. Please refer the link below for more detailed information on this. * [Trade-In Policy](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/support/news?postId=233762c17aa04616bb0367f0f9561371) **License ID (End User) detail section** Clicking the individual license ID (End User) from the previous image on the left hand side, will lead you to the single End User detail page. In this page, you can manage End User IDs by viewing the user details, your password for the End User, the email address and the IP address when the license is being used at corporate premises. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438008453657) _(sample image)_ **What Else Can I Expect from License Account Admin page?** **User Pool** Within User Pool feature we provide, licenses are now much flexible in terms of management. Please read a separate manual followed by the link below, for better understanding of the usability around this feature. * [**User Pool Manual**](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358149827609) **Invoice** In the invoice section, you can view your past orders and invoices. You can also add and edit your billing address within this section.

title: Set Fabric Textures
content: ### Objective Represents the pattern or texture of the fabric. ### Location Object Browser ▶ Fabric Tab ### Operation 1. Click the menu at the indicated location. 2. Select a fabric item. → Fabric properties appear in the Property Editor. 3. Set the basic material by referring to the table below. #### PBR (Default) Option | Description ---|--- Texture Repeat Type (Ver. 10) / Texture Mapping (Ver. 11) | Repeat | Repeatedly display the texture on the pattern. Unified Map | Display the texture based on the pattern layout of the UV map. [Repeat UV Settings] * Repeat U: Size the texture based on U direction. * Repeat V: Size the texture based on V direction. The number 1 means that the texture is repeated once between 0-1 of the UV map. Type | Set the appropriate Material Type. ※Note: If garment is created in Marvelous Designer or Downloaded from CONNECT, the fabric type may display as * (Read-only) Fabric Type with the same name in Marvelous Designer. However, since there is no render engine in Marvelous Designer, the fabric display in 3D window will not be accurate. Base Color (ver. 2025.0) | Color | Select your chosen color from the color wheel or leave as (None) Base Color Map | Recolor | Remove the default color to apply other colors while retaining the pattern or texture. Desaturate | It desaturates the color of the graphics. Set the Shadow Intensity and Shadow Brightness. Switch | Easily and quickly switch the color of solid fabric to a new one without losing the accuracy of the chosen color. ![Switch Color.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47358364190105) ※Note: For consistent results, the Base Color Map should contain 1 color. If the Base Color Map contains multiple colors, users may experience unexpected or unintended results. Texture | Click the explore button and apply a texture image from Library/Folder ※Note: Click both back and side tabs and deactivate 'Use Same Materials as Front' to apply different materials to other faces of the pattern. Remove Texture Color | Remove the default color to apply other colors while retaining the pattern or texture. Normal Map | Apply Normal Map image to express uneven texture more realistically. Automatic | When a texture is applied, Normal Map is generated by adjusting the Intensity. Higher intensity makes the embossed detail raised off the surface, the lower intensity makes the details lower than the surface. Manual | Click the explore or apply the Normal Map image from the Library/Folder ※Note: Use the normal map image made with the exclusive tool to achieve an accurate normal effect. Also, add a normal map that is different with texture in order to create an extra pattern of surface. Displacement Map (ver.11) | Express thickness or bumpiness of fabrics or textures. As displacement maps are grey-scaled, their height is determined by the level of darkness of the grey color. ※ Note: * Increase the image resolution and apply the Gaussian Blur effect to express the texture smoothly. * Displacement map's minimum particle distance value is now 0.01 mm to allow for greater mesh density for displacement map (Ver. 2024.1) Amount | Adjust the maximum height of the displacement map. The white area of the displacement map shows the maximum height. Shift | Adjust the distance between the displacement map and the garment surface Clipping | Adjust to delete all geometries below the Clipping value. Particle Distance | Adjust the Particle Distance of newly created meshes. ※ Note: As more memory is used for lower Particle Distance, it is recommended not to set the Particle Distance below 1 for a wide area. Keep Continuity | Extend the adjacent face to eliminate the boundary line. ※ Note: Only applicable to Welded OBJs. Color | Express each of the fabrics in various colorways Opacity | Adjust Opacity to create sheer fabric. ※Note: When you apply opacity to texture, change Garment Rendering Style as Thick Textured Surface. Alpha Map (ver. 10) | Express level of transparency using a grayscale image map RGB Mode | The encoded map with alpha value in RGB channel. Alpha Mode | The encoded map with alpha value in alpha channel. Roughness | Intensity | Edit fabric gloss by adjusting Intensity of the Roughness Map | Edit fabric gloss by adding and modifying Roughness Map. Map | Select the Browse button next to the Map option to add a Roughness Map to the selected Fabric style. Map Intensity | Adjust the Map's Intensity. The range of Roughness map intensity was enlarged in (ver. 2024.2) Invert | Select to invert the gloss of the fabric. When this option is selected, the shinny part becomes dull and vice-versa. To use Specular Maps provided in below ver. 6, check this option. Reflection Intensity | Greater the Reflection Intensity value is, more reflective than the material or fabric is and vice-versa. Metalness (ver. 10) | Adjust metallic level. Higher value makes the surface more metallic. Metalness Map (ver. 10) | Partially express metallics using a grayscale image. The white parts of the map appear metallic. ※Note: * When working with Metalness Map, control Roughness Intensity and Reflection Intensity level that are suitable for the metallic texture. (e.g. Roughness Intensity 10, Reflection Intensity 90) * For the non-metallic areas(matte), assign the same metalness map to Roughness Map, and turn on Invert. #### Substance (ver. 10) Set the file format as Substance at the right menu of Material, you can use SBSAR file of Substance which is the main application of physical based rendering. To get a better rendering result for substance materials, enable High-Quality Render on 3D window. Properties | Description ---|--- Substance File | Import SBSAR file by clicking 'Explore' or, download SBSAR file by clicking 'Go to Substance Source'. * SBSAR file can be imported by Object Browser> Right-click on Fabric item. Preset | Choose the preset of SBSAR. Resolution | Adjust the image resolution of SBSAR. Custom Properties | Edit the properties of SBSAR. ※Note: Custom Properties are different depending on the property of the file. Refer to the [Substance Manual](https://docs.substance3d.com/home) for more detailed information. ※ Note: * Clicking on a Fabric from the Fabric List is going to highlight the Patterns where the Fabric is being applied to, in the 3D/2D window. * Clicking on a Pattern in the 3D or 2D window is going to highlight the Fabric where it is being applied to, in the Object Browser ▶ Fabric Tab.

title: ZIPPER: Zipper Slider and Stopper Properties
content: ### Objective Set and modify the Zipper Slider, puller and Stopper properties. ※ Note: The Puller, Slider, and Stopper of the zipper have been separated so that each can be individually selected and edited. (Ver. 2025.0). ### Location 3D Toolbar ▶ Select/Move ### Operation * Select the tool indicated in Location. * Select a Zipper or Stopper created on a 3D Garment and modify its properties: Option | Description ---|--- Name | Customize the name of the zipper. Type (Ver. 2025.0) | One Way | One slider and puller is shown. Two Way | Two sliders and pullers are shown which can be moved in opposite directions. Direction (Ver. 2025.0) | Direction can be configured when the type is set to Two Way. Bottom to Bottom | Slider and Puller will be positioned near the Stopper, at the end of the zipper. Head to Head | Slider and Puller will be positioned of the original position. Shape | Slider | Select a shape for the slider. Puller | Select a shape for the puller. Stopper | Select the Stopper type (Open / Closed End) and then select shapes for Top and Bottom. (ver MD10) ※ Note: A selection of Bottom shapes is configured based on the shape of the Stopper. Specification | Gauge | Select the size of the Slider by Gauge or percentage. Weight (g) | Assign the weight of the slider. (Ver 4.2) Fasten Zipper | Reverse Zip Direction | Select the zip direction. The slider is relocated based on the option. Move to Opposite Side | Select a side of the zipper tape where the slider will locate when the zipper is open. Material | Configure the Slider's Type, Texture, Color, and Opacity. ※ Note: Uncheck Use Same Material as Slider after selecting the Puller or Stopper tab to assign material separately. (Ver. 10) Polygon Optimization (Ver. 2024.0) | Count | Set the number of polygons. Plane | This is applied in the form of a texture when the Plane is activated. Count cannot be set on Plane activation. ※ Note: * Adjust the weight of the Slider
content_description: This web page serves as a comprehensive guide for users to set and modify the properties of Zipper components, including the Slider, Puller, and Stopper, within a 3D garment design environment.

title: TOPSTITCH PROPERTIES: Topstitch Corner Type
content: ### Objective Set Topstitch corner type to extend the stitch more smoothly at corners. ※ Note: If stitch type is Overlock, set the corner type to Curved for smoother extension. ### Location 2D Pattern Window ▶ Edit Topstitch ▶ Topstitch Property Editor ▶ Corner ### Operation #### Curved Corner 1. Select a Topstitch with the Edit Topstitch tool in the 2D window to change its properties. → Topstitch properties appear on the Property Editor. 2. Follow the indicated guideline below: Topstitch Property Editor ▶ Curved ▶ On → The selected Topstitch is now curved and smoothly extended. #### Right Angled Corner 1. Select a Topstitch with the Edit Topstitch tool in the 2D window to change its properties. → Topstitch properties appear on the Property Editor. 2. Follow the indicated guideline below: Topstitch Property Editor ▶ Right Angled ▶ On → The selected topstitch is now being curved at a right angle. #### Topstitching Smooth Corner 1. Select a Topstitch with the Edit Topstitch tool in the 2D window to change its properties. → Topstitch properties appear on the Property Editor. 2. Follow the indicated guideline below: Topstitch Property Editor ▶ Smooth ▶ On → The selected Topstitch is now curved and smoothly extended. Set this to continue naturally if the edge of the Topstitch is broken.
content_description: This web page provides guidance on adjusting topstitch corner types in the 2D Pattern Window to achieve smoother stitch extensions at corners.

title: Seamline Property (ver. 2025.0)
content: ### Objective Adjust Seamline properties such as line types, tension, sublayers, topstitch, puckering, and 3D Seamline Normal Maps to render a realistic Garment. ### ### Location Main Menu ▶ Sewing ▶ Edit Sewing (B) 2D Toolbar ▶ Edit Sewing (B) ### Operation 1. Select the tool/menu indicated in Location. 2. Click on any point or segment of the Sewing Line to display the Property Editor. Properties | Description ---|--- Seam | Open | Open a Sewing Style Preset File (*.ssp). Save | The current properties can be saved as a Sewing Style Preset File (.ssp) type file. Information | Name | Set the name of the currently selected sewing line. Sewing Line Type | Turned (Off) | Fold Strength | The intensity of the fold is able to be set by adjusting the value of Fold Strength. The higher the value, the closer the fold is to the set angle. When a jacket and its lining are sewn together, the sewn area inflates due to the default sewing angle and intensity values. In this case, set the Fold Strength to 0 to flatten the sewn boundaries. Fold Angle | 180° represents a flat state. The internal line is folded towards the front of the pattern as the fold angle is closer to 0˚ and is folded into the back of the pattern as the angle is closer to 360˚. Turned (On) | Sew two layers of pattern flatly. The Fold Strength and Fold Angle settings cannot be adjusted. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438049347737) Tension | When the 3D garment is expressed as being stretched more than the actual garment, adjust the Tension of Sewing Line. Same as the actual real life concept, Tension is applied based on the short or long side with the Ease and Stretch options. Sewing Line Type | Ease | When the seam lengths differ, this type adds a slight allowance, resulting in a relatively soft sewing tension. Stretch | When the seam lengths differ, this type does not add any allowance, resulting in a more precise and higher sewing tension. Strength | Increase or decrease the strength of the sewing tension by entering the value. The result may vary depending on the Strength even with the same Ratio value. Ratio | Adjust the sewing tension's ratio to express varying drape effects by different sewing methods. Set Sublayer | Assign orders to the Sewing Lines on a Pattern that folds on itself such as seam allowances and pleats, to increase simulation stability. Reverse Direction | Swap the order of the Sewing Line and the Sewed Line. Sublayer | Decide which side of the fabric is attached to the fixed Sewing Line, Back or Front. Topstitch | Name | Rename the Topstitch. Topstitch Property | Change the style of the selected Topstitch. Extend | When the start or end point of a Topstitch does not reach or sticks out of the Pattern outline, extend it to fit to the Pattern. Corner | Curved | Set the Topstitch corner type to extend the stitch more smoothly at corners. Right Angled | Set the Topstitch to be a right angle in the corner of the pattern. Smooth | Set it to continue naturally if the edge of the Topstitch is broken. Offset | Set the Z Offset of the Topstitch. Placement | Seam A | Topstitch will be shown only on Seam A. Seam B | Topstitch will be shown only on Seam B. Seam Both | Topstitch will be shown on both sides. Puckering | Name | Rename the Puckering. Puckering Property | Change the style of the selected Topstitch. Extend | Extend the start/endpoint of the puckering to the 2D pattern outline. Offset | Offset (mm) | Adjust the distance between the puckering and the pattern outline. Include the Puckering Width in Offset or not if needed. Z Offset (mm) | Adjust the distance between the Z-axis and a pattern piece. Placement | Seam A | Puckering will be shown only on Seam A. Seam B | Puckering will be shown only on Seam B. Seam Both | Puckering will be shown on both sides. 3D Seamline | Plain Seam | Normal Map | Select an image to be used as the Normal Map. Intensity | Adjust the intensity of the Normal Map applied to the seamline. Thickness (mm) | Adjust the thickness of the Normal Map applied to the seamline. Directional | Placement | Select Seam A or Seam B for the placement of the seamline. Normal Map | Select an image to be used as the Normal Map. Intensity | Adjust the intensity of the Normal Map applied to the seamline. Thickness (mm) | Adjust the thickness of the Normal Map applied to the seamline.
content_description: This webpage provides detailed instructions on how to adjust seamline properties in garment design software for realistic rendering, including settings for line types, tension, sublayers, topstitching, puckering, and 3D normal maps.

title: ZIPPER: Zipper Tape Properties
content: ### Objective Modify the Zipper tape properties. ### ### Location 3D Toolbar ▶ Select/Move ▶ Zipper Tape (Click On Zipper Tape)▶ Property Editor ### Operation 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: 3D Toolbar ▶ Select/Move ▶ Zipper Tape (Click On Zipper Tape)▶ Property Editor → The properties of the selected Zipper Tape appear in the Property Editor. 2. Modify the Zipper Tape properties based on the available options below: **Properties** | **Description** ---|--- Name | Rename the Zipper Tape. Line Length | Edit the length of the Zipper teeth. Preset (ver. 2025.0) | Set the preset of the Zipper from Custom, Plastic_01, Plastic_02, Metal, Nylon, Reverse_Nylon, Invisible. Texture (ver. 2025.0) | Set the Teeth type to Texture or OBJ. Size (ver.11) | Set the size of the Zipper. Teeth Width | Enter directly the width of the Zipper to adjust. Total Width | Adjust the Tape width of the Zipper. Width | Set the width of the Zipper Tape. The texture image changes based on the width entered. Thickness | Set the Zipper Tape Thickness. Particle Distance | Adjust zipper tape's Particle Distance. Fasten Zipper | Zip or unzip the Zipper. Fold | Adjust the Strength of the fold for Sewing between the Zipper and Pattern. Material | Set the Material Type, Texture, Color and Opacity of the Zipper Teeth and Tape. Physical Property | Adjust physical properties to the selected zipper teeth.
